caption:
More ad spend does not fix a broken shop.

It just proves the leak faster. If your close rate sits at 20 percent, doubling your leads does not change that percentage. You just pay more to lose the same share.

Most shops take hours to call back a new lead. Shops that call back within minutes close more deals before a competitor gets through.

Fix the system. Then scale the spend.
